positioning_cot.source: hash-checked annual.txt from 2023, 2024 and 2025 CFTC zip archives; 117 Gold reports
positioning_cot.formula: noncommercial and commercial net counts divided by open interest; four-report ratio difference and open-interest log difference
positioning_cot.asof: report as_of plus seven calendar days, strict before M5 decision; late-publication exception dates are outside this development sample

panel_oanda.source: 11 H1 parquet files read in chronological batches through development cutoff; 6166 to 6721 H1 rows and 279 to 319 D1 bars per instrument in independent window
panel_oanda.formula: independent 22:00 UTC D1 session grouping, last close, log close difference over 1/5/20 observed D1 bars, 20-return sample standard deviation ddof=1
panel_oanda.asof: D1 label plus 24 hours, inclusive at M5 decision
panel_oanda.units: log returns and return standard deviation, dimensionless

drivers.source: pinned Treasury, Cboe VIX and SPDR GLD primitive parsers, then separately recomputed union-date arithmetic through 2025-03; 9064 source union dates before cutoff
drivers.formula: levels, percentage-point differences, slope and breakeven, log VIX and log tonnes and their differences; delta(k) follows frozen union-date after-forward-fill semantics
drivers.asof: observation date D at New York midnight D+2, strict before M5 decision
drivers.units: Treasury levels/changes in percent/percentage points; VIX and GLD log levels/changes dimensionless

execution.comparison: finite masks identical and numpy.isclose(atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6) on finite values

next_gate: Audit source-first warmup and exact historical publication/revision clocks where evidence exists; then quantify field contribution only under a predeclared chronological development hypothesis. Native optimizer admission remains closed.
